RN-01  l：Material Description: 1. Storefront Material Requirements: According to the drawing design requirements, the storefront material shall be aluminum oxide composite panel finish: LED LOGO shall be constructed in strict accordance with the drawing requirements: Walls: Unless otherwise specified, 100# light steel keel partitions shall be used for all newly built walls: Wall Treatment: 1. Micro-cement texture paint 2. inorganic paint 3. waterproof coating: 1. black titanium stainless steel + A-grade soft film Floor: Floor tiles will be provided by the supplier and the layout will be confirmed. 4.   Construction Note:  Design elevation and dimensions: 1. The elevations noted in the drawing are set with the elevation of ± 0.00. 2. All dimensions indicated in the construction drawing are in "mm", other than elevations, which are in "m". 3. The dimensions indicated in this construction drawing shall be subject to the dimensions indicated on the drawing, and shall not be measured and calculated according to the scale of the drawing. Fire protection design: 1. The fire protection rating of all fire doors shall be selected according to the original building design grade. See the materials shown in the elevation for the decorative surface. 2. Please see the table of materials for details of the fire rating of interior decoration materials of the building. Roofing materials shall be Class A non-combustible materials, and the floor and wall materials shall be Class B1 flame-retardant materials. 3. All base course materials shall meet the fire prevention and other requirements of special acceptance of fire control and quality inspection departments. 4. All walkway partition walls shall be built with floor slab (beam) bottom, transverse (vertical) holes and gaps on floor slab and partition wall, and seams and pipeline crossings shall be sealed and filled with non-combustible materials within the same fire resistance limit. Ceiling:  Partition walls: 1. Unless otherwise specified, the light steel keel partition walls are made of 75 or 100 series keel; see the wall legend and detailed drawings. 2. Weigh light steel keel frame according to the board wall, light steel keel spacing ≤ 400MM, parts above and below should be fixed firmly. Then set the auxiliary keel and put on the keel connector. Inorganic coating wall finish: 1. For single-layer 12mm thick paper gypsum board, the interface of gypsum board must be on the keel with a gap of ±3MM, and the lines shall be strictly straight; 2. The gypsum board screws shall be rustproof with a spacing of < 250-300mm. The screws shall be tightened and the gypsum board shall not be damaged. All wood should be painted with fireproof paint. 3. The joint shall be leveled with special joint bandage, special glue and embedded with special putty. 4. All exposed iron parts shall be coated with red primer for rust prevention, and one primer and two top coats shall be applied in case of inorganic coating. Aluminum plate wall finish: 1. Inspect the wall quality, clean and reinforce. 2. According to the drawing, the stainless steel plate shall be separated and typeset in combination with the actual size on site. 3. Snap lines on the wall, embed the fixings and galvanized steel and metal fixings (for concrete walls, they can be directly fixed on the wall, and for light block partition walls, they can be fixed to the ceiling and floor or fixed on the ring beam). All structural fixings need to be galvanized to prevent corrosion. 4. Stainless steel finish, grooving and folding to ensure surface flatness and neat gap. The purchased materials and accessories can be used only after being checked and confirmed that they are qualified.  5.   Other notes:  1. The design of this project shall beimplemented according to current regulations and construction regulations of China. In case of any conflict between this document and the regulations, please contact the designer. 2. The construction party must study and verify all dimensions and be responsible for them; in the event of any changes, the designer shall be promptly notified. 3. All selected materials shall be subject to the material samples; the construction party shall provide corresponding material samples, and only when they are approved by the designer and the owner could the construction work be carried out. 4. Relevant disciplines for water, electricity, wind and other relevant electromechanical works shall closely coordinate with each other during the construction. In case of any unclarity or inconsistency, please promptly contact the designer to resolve the issue together. 5. All ports on the decorative surface shall be factory made, and their colors shall be close to those of the finish materials unless otherwise specified. if any unclarity or inconsistency is found, contact the design party in time to jointly resolve it. 6. The construction party shall be responsible for the safety of finish base, large lamps, furniture, fixtures and other fixtures within the construction; for important parts, the corresponding embedding, reinforcement and installation drawings shall be provided to the designer for confirmation, to ensure safety. 7. Each supplier shall verify the size on the site to ensure that the installation is appropriate. If there is any doubt, the designer shall be promptly notified. 8. All construction processes and practices not mentioned in the design drawings shall be performed in accordance with GB50210-2001, Code for Construction Quality Acceptance of Building Decoration. 9. Please refer to the relevant drawings for the installation of water, electricity and air.  6.   Construction Requirements:  The construction party shall strictly comply with relevant laws and regulations regarding construction projects as well as the quality acceptance specifications regarding the building decoration projects. It is strictly forbidden to work without a permit, and the measures regarding the configuration of temporary electricity usage, noise, dust, odor, lighting, and public disturbance prevention during construction shall comply with relevant construction regulations. The person responsible for managing on-site workers of the construction party shall have relevant knowledge and professional capability in construction process, design, construction drawings, construction engineering regulations and specifications, communication and coordination.  ll：Special notes:  In order to cater forInsta360's nationwide identity promotion and maintain the same design style, the construction party, supporting units and manufacturers are requested to carefully review the drawings before proceeding with the construction. For any problems not specified in this design set, your company or the project leader of the construction unit shall communicate with our company and we will respond as soon as possible. Thank you for cooperation! At the same time, please cooperate with us in terms of the following matters: -   Before and during the construction, the construction party must first review the drawings and prepare detailed construction and schedule plans. In case of any problems, please contact the designer immediately to explain the situation in detail. Any inconsistency between the site conditions and drawings, and relevant issues during the construction shall be submitted to the design team for confirmation before relevant construction processes are implemented, issues affecting the design shall be communicated with the design team for confirmation before the construction. It is not allowed to modify the plan or carry out construction without authorization; -   The construction party is required to print the construction drawings according to the size of the paper received, and must be constructed according to the drawings. All dimensions are not allowed to be measured directly in the drawing, and all dimensions shall be subject to the data marked in the drawing. -   After receiving the full set of drawings, please call our designer promptly to confirm the start date and demolition date, so that our supervisors can make their schedule accordingly and ensure timely and effective delivery of the works. -   After the demolition, the construction party shall measure the site dimensions and record the problem dimensions. Carefully review the construction drawings, and make a trial setout on the site. -   Our supervisors arrive at the site to confirm that the setting out is correct, and then carry out next step of construction; Confirm the component order at the same time. -   Please call the designer after the store is opened, and our company will arrange the completion acceptance of the store.  Ground (floor tiles finish): 1. The ground shall be paved in strict accordance with the direction marked on the drawing line. 2. Base leveling: According to the design elevation of the floor, use 1: 3 dry hard cement mortar leveling, pull horizontal through line at the reference point for laying. Before paving and plastering the dry and hard cement mortar on the base course, the plain cement slurry shall be evenly plastered on the surface of the base course to increase the adhesion between the base course and the leveling course. 3. Floor tile laying, maintenance. Lamps, circuit: 1. Electrical installation and construction personnel shall be certified. 2. The lamps shall be installed in strict accordance with the direction marked on the drawing line. 3. The pipeline route, elevation and other positions shall be determined according to the position of lamps, sockets and distribution box in drawing. When wiring the power line, the cross section of the conductor used shall meet the maximum output power of the electrical equipment. The main power distribution box shall be placed in the warehouse as far as possible, and no rocker switch shall be set in the mall area. 4. Adjust the best illumination angle of lamps in time after the store is opened.  Design and construction notes  2. Wood board, wood keel, wood strip and other materials shall not be used on site. B1 flame retardant board shall be used for wall base course, and Class A flame retardant board shall be used for top base course. 1. The ceiling (main and auxiliary keels are U60) package should be accessible for maintenance. Main and auxiliary keels are all national standard 60*27*1.2 keels. The spacing between main keels is no more than 800mm, the spacing between auxiliary keels is no more than 300mm, and the spacing between hanging bars of the ceiling is no less than 0.8m. The suspender is 10MM galvanized threaded rod, and cannot be fixed on the main beam. Transfer layer or reverse support shall be provided if the length of hanging bar exceeds 1.5m; 2. Set up the access hole according to the installation of equipment and valves in the ceiling. The size of the access hole shall not be less than 600MM*600MM, and the surrounding of the access hole must be reinforced. Design notes  Electrical design notes  1. Project overview This project is the electrical design of Insta360 construction drawings. The design scope includes the lighting, power supply, and comprehensive wiring of the business hall. 2. Basis for Design: 1.Code for Electrical Design of Civil Buildings JGJ 16-2018 2.Code for Fire Protection Design of Buildings GB50016-2018 3.Code for Fire Protection Design of Building Interior Decoration GB50222-2017 4.Architectural Lighting Design Standard BG50034-2017 5.Relevant engineering requirements provided by Party A 3. Power supply part: 1. Negotiate with Party A to determine the incoming power supply, which is required to be three-phase four wire ~ 220V / 380V power supply, and the length of power incoming cable shall be adjusted according to the actual situation on site. 2. A new distribution box shall be built. The air switch in the distribution box shall be installed according to the system diagram, and the position of the distribution box can be adjusted according to the actual situation. 4. Lighting: 1. The fluorescent lamp of the project uses high-quality electronic ballast to make its power factor to be over 0.85. 2. Where not indicated, the distribution box shall be installed 1.5m above the ground, the rocker switch shall be installed 1.3m above the ground, and the socket shall be installed 0.3m above the ground. 3. The emergency light with battery device shall be set, and the emergency responding time shall be more than 90 minutes 5. Cable laying: 1.The lighting uses halogen-free low smoke flame retardant copper core plastic insulated conductor (WDZA-500-3*2.5 square meters), passing through KGB galvanized steel pipe, concealed along the ceiling and wall, and 2-3 pieces through JDG20 pipe. 4-5 pieces through JDG25 pipes. Power sockets use halogen-free low-smoke flame retardant copper-core plastic insulated wires (WDZA-500-3*2.5 square) through KGB galvanized steel pipe, along the top and wall. Concealed laying. Put 2-3 pieces through KGB20 tubes and 4-5 pieces through KGB25 tubes. 2.The pipelines shall be fixed firmly, and there shall be jumper wire between strong current pipelines. 3. Spacing of suspenders shall be 1.2m; independent suspenders shall be used for pipelines, and the same suspenders shall not be used with ceiling or weak current pipelines. 4. The distance from the weak current pipelines shall be greater than 300mm. 5.The wire connector shall be set in the junction box, and the junction must be hung with tin, wrapped tightly without bare wire; all junction boxes must be fitted with box covers. 6.The spacing between bridge suspenders is 1.5m; after construction, the bridge cover plate must be fastened; Jumper wires must be set at the bridge connection. 6. Weak current electricity:  1.Consult with Party A, contact with telecommunication department or shopping mall in time to determine the location and way of introducing network cables and telephone lines.  2.Computer terminal, computer information cables should use class VI network cable, passing through JDG galvanized steel pipe, and concealed along the ceiling and wall.2-3 pieces through JDG20 tube,4 pieces through JDG25 tube.   The telephone line uses special telephone line RVB － 2 * 05.1 – 3 pieces through KGB16 tube.  3.The wire type of other monitoring, speaker, access control and other weak current systems shall be confirmed according to the specific equipment selected. It shall be laid through JDG galvanized steel pipes and concealed along the ceiling and wall. All generic cabling terminals and local area network cabling   A length of more than 2m shall be reserved at both ends, and the serial number shall be marked in the terminal and distribution frame in the cabinet, which shall be clear and accurate. The telephone line in the machine room needs to be equipped with a wiring terminal rack.  4.The pipeline shall be firmly fixed, and the spacing of suspenders shall be 1.2m; independent suspenders shall be used for pipelines, and the same suspenders shall not be used with suspended ceiling or strong current pipelines. The distance from strong current pipelines shall be greater than 300mm. 5.The position of socket junction box shall comply with the drawing design, and the installation shall be firm and square. 6.The spacing between bridge suspenders shall not be greater than 1.5m; after construction, the bridge cover plate must be fastened. 7. Fire safety part:  1.Fire evacuation instructions and emergency lighting points shall comply with the drawing design.  2.The setting points of fire hydrants shall meet the requirements of drawings and fire protection specifications.  3.The fire smoke detector alarm system (pipe line setting) shall comply with the drawing design; the installation position and quantity of smoke detectors meet the design requirements; independent pipelines and independent suspenders are used for fire wires.  4.The spray pipe diameter and point setting shall comply with the drawing design and fire protection specifications. 5.The formal drawings issued by the fire fighting authority shall prevail.  8. Air-conditioning part:  1.The size and laying path of air duct shall comply with the drawing design; The cross arm uses L30x3 angle steel and Φ8 suspenders with spacing less than 2m.  2.Independent suspenders are required for air conditioning cold and hot water pipes, copper pipes and other pipelines, with a spacing of 1.5m; the unit is closely connected with hot and cold water pipes, condensate pipes, air vents, etc.  3.For air-conditioning wires, independent pipelines and independent suspenders are required; independent power supplies are required for air-conditioners, and the same circuit required for indoor units of the same unit.  4.When connecting wires with equipment, soft wire tubes can be used for connection, but the length shall not be greater than 1.5m. 5.The formal drawings issued by the air conditioning supplier shall prevail. 9. Grounding: 1.The original grounding wire shall be adopted, and all metal parts that are not electrified under normal conditions shall be reliably grounded. 2. Electronic equipment shall be reliably grounded, the measured grounding resistance shall be less than 1Ω, and the null-ground AC voltage shall be less than 4V. When the actual quantity cannot be met, the grounding electrode shall be added. 10. Others: １.During construction, in order to facilitate future maintenance, all piping shall be laid parallel along the wall ２.The line in this drawing only indicates the wiring mode and circuit distribution, not the actual routing position and length. It shall be determined according to the actual situation during construction. 3.When Party A configures the air-conditioning unit, the power cord should be complied with the power reservation. 4.According to the actual installation of lamps and equipment, the three-phase current shall be measured on site, and the three phases shall be basically balanced (the imbalance degree shall not be greater than 15%). 5.Matters not covered in the drawings shall be implemented in strict accordance with the current relevant national specifications.
